meta.name: eol-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Run a go/no-go assessment for retiring a product or feature, then right-size the effort. Use when someone says "we should probably kill this" and nobody has made the call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估产品是否该退役,并规划后续投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队对是否下架某个产品或功能迟迟做不了决定。
copy.tagline_en: Decide whether to retire a product and right-size the wind-down effort.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team can't decide whether to kill a product or feature.

howto.what: 装好后，说到要停用一个产品或功能，Claude 会问最多四个问题，然后给出“该停/有条件地停/先别停”的结论，建议投入轻、中、重哪个力度，并列出合同、客户等不能忽略的义务。
howto.when: 当有人说“我们也许该砍掉这个”但没人拍板时，或你直接要求对某产品或功能做 EOL 就绪检查时触发。

say.text: 这个老报表模块该退役吗？使用量跌了60%，支持成本在涨。
say.note: Claude 会启动四个问题的评估流程。

say.text: 帮我对 NFA-200 控制器线做 EOL 检查，120 个安装，有渠道伙伴。
say.note: 他会评估影响范围和强度等级。

say.text: 领导说该砍掉这个模块，但没人拍板，帮我评估。
say.note: 会给出明确的裁决和后续步骤。

howto.what_en: After installing, if you propose retiring a product/feature, Claude asks up to four questions, then gives a verdict (go/conditions/hold/harvest), an effort level (light/standard/heavy), and obligations to check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone says 'we should probably kill this' and no one has made the call, or when you ask for an EOL readiness assessment.

say_en.text: Should we retire the legacy reporting module? Usage down 60%, support costs up.
EOL readiness check on the NFA-200 line — 120 installs, channel partners.
Leadership says kill this module but no one decides — help me assess.
say_en.note: Gives a verdict and next steps.
